title: News is More than a Collection of Facts: Moral Frame Preserving News Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Expert evaluation of generated news summaries to detect 'Moral Framing Addition' and 'Moral Framing Modification', which identify instances where language models inadvertently project their own internal moral biases onto neutral segments. The study also uses an automated 'MoralDivergence' metric to measure the shift in the distribution of Moral Foundation Theory (MFT) categories between the source articles and the generated summaries.
